guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 區分液化觸發、永久變形與改善覆蓋的驗證需求。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Separate liquefaction triggering, permanent deformation and verified treatment coverage. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設總垂直應力σv=150kPa、孔壓u=100kPa，σ′v=σv−u=50kPa；此為指定深度的初始狀態，不是液化判定。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設amax/g=0.30、σv/σ′v=2、rd=0.90，CSR=0.65(amax/g)(σv/σ′v)rd=0.351；各因子都採用無因次比值。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設已相容修正CRR=0.40、CSR=0.351，FS=CRR/CSR=1.14；數值是教學比值，不作現地驗收門檻。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設初始σ′v0=100kPa、循環增加Δu=95kPa，ru=Δu/σ′v0=0.95；若總應力近似固定，殘餘有效應力約5kPa。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設兩層厚H1=3m、H2=4m，震後體積應變εv1=0.02、εv2=0.01，S=Σ εviHi=0.02×3+0.01×4=0.10m。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設兩側相對永久位移Δ=0.30m、變形帶寬L=5m，γ≈Δ/L=0.06即6%；這不是由震級直接推算的位移。
factsEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At a selected depth with σv=150kPa and u=100kPa, σ′v=50kPa. This is an initial state, not a liquefaction determination.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For amax/g=0.30, σv/σ′v=2 and rd=0.90, CSR=0.65×0.30×2×0.90=0.351; all factors are dimensionless.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With compatibly corrected CRR=0.40 and CSR=0.351, FS=1.14. This teaching ratio is not a field acceptance threshold.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For initial σ′v0=100kPa and cyclic Δu=95kPa, ru=0.95. Approximately fixed total stress leaves about5kPa effective stress.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For H1=3m, H2=4m, εv1=0.02 and εv2=0.01, S=Σ εviHi=0.10m, assuming predominantly vertical, one-dimensional reconsolidation of both layers.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For relative permanent movement Δ=0.30m across L=5m, γ≈0.06, or6%. This assumed movement is not derived directly from earthquake magnitude.
timeline: 2002　灣區捷運完成系統耐震脆弱度研究
2011　美國聯邦公路管理局列出岩土耐震參考手冊
2017　美國聯邦公路管理局列出地盤改良參考手冊
timelineEn: 2002 — BART completes a system seismic vulnerability study
2011 — FHWA lists its seismic geotechnical reference manual
2017 — FHWA lists its ground modification reference manual
codes: 美國聯邦公路管理局GEC3岩土與基礎耐震手冊，2011
美國聯邦公路管理局GEC13地盤改良方法第一冊，2017
codesEn: FHWA GEC3 Seismic Geotechnical Features and Foundations, 2011
FHWA GEC13 Ground Modification Methods Volume I, 2017
landmarks: 跨灣隧道：液化與接頭需求比較
基督城南部高速公路：地盤改善比較
landmarksEn: Transbay Tube: liquefaction and joint demand comparison
Christchurch Southern Motorway: ground improvement comparison
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出埋深或斷面、地質水文、支護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, ground and groundwater, support system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：液化地盤評估與改善
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Liquefaction assessment and mitigation
guides.concept: 本課聚焦區分液化觸發、永久變形與改善覆蓋的驗證需求。十個單元依序辨識作用機制、量化假設、驗證程序與故障徵兆，讓學徒追蹤從原始資料到工程判斷的每一環。每個算例都帶單位與限制，不把局部成功或單一比值當成完整系統合格。交接須保留基準、異常與權責工程師核准的條件。
guides.conceptEn: This course focuses on separate liquefaction triggering, permanent deformation and verified treatment coverage. Ten units connect mechanisms, numerical assumptions, verification procedures and failure symptoms so apprentices can trace each inference from evidence to judgment. Every example includes units and limitations; one successful observation or ratio does not establish system acceptance. Handover retains datums, anomalies and conditions approved by the responsible engineer.
procedure: 土骨架承擔的有效應力等於總應力扣除孔壓，地震快速循環可改變孔壓而不立即改變上覆重量。初始狀態必須由地層、地下水與應力歷史共同建立。假設總垂直應力σv=150kPa、孔壓u=100kPa，σ′v=σv−u=50kPa；此為指定深度的初始狀態，不是液化判定。若把總應力當有效應力，循環需求與抗力修正都可能失真；實際水位較高時初始骨架應力更低，原本看似充足的安全餘裕可能消失。

簡化循環應力比把地表加速度、應力比與深度折減整合，用於相容方法內的觸發分析。它不是完整時域土體反應，複雜場址與重要構造可能需要更深入分析。假設amax/g=0.30、σv/σ′v=2、rd=0.90，CSR=0.65(amax/g)(σv/σ′v)rd=0.351；各因子都採用無因次比值。將基岩加速度直接當地表值或把峰值加速度單位錯用為g，會系統性改變需求；忽略場址放大時，錯誤不會因資料表計算精確而消失。
循環抗力與需求必須處於同一震級、應力及修正基準，才可相除成觸發指標。比值超過一仍不直接證明永久位移、局部薄層及整體系統皆可接受。假設已相容修正CRR=0.40、CSR=0.351，FS=CRR/CSR=1.14；數值是教學比值，不作現地驗收門檻。把不同文獻的修正係數任意混用，可能在無察覺下高估抗力；平均比值大於一也可能掩蓋連續薄弱層，造成側移或地盤支承能力突變。
高超額孔壓比代表初始有效應力大幅耗減，但實際土體應力路徑及循環剪應變仍重要。不能把一個感測點的比值當整場地同時完全液化的證據。假設初始σ′v0=100kPa、循環增加Δu=95kPa，ru=Δu/σ′v0=0.95；若總應力近似固定，殘餘有效應力約5kPa。感測器量程不足可把更大的反應截成固定值，或漏氣使峰值偏低；只看單點最大比值而不查波形，會錯判液化範圍與後續變形需求。
震後排水與再密實造成體積變形，沉陷需按層厚與體積應變積分。估計應變應來自合適方法，不能用觸發安全比值直接線性換算地表下沉。假設兩層厚H1=3m、H2=4m，震後體積應變εv1=0.02、εv2=0.01，S=Σ εviHi=0.02×3+0.01×4=0.10m。遺漏薄但高應變的夾層會低估總沉陷；相同平均沉陷在相鄰位置若分布不同，結構接頭可能已超限，不能只用場地總平均判斷可使用性。
液化區鄰近自由面或斜坡可能產生永久側向位移，對埋管及隧道接頭的需求和垂直沉陷不同。平均剪應變只能描述選定帶寬，局部剪切集中還需細化。假設兩側相對永久位移Δ=0.30m、變形帶寬L=5m，γ≈Δ/L=0.06即6%；這不是由震級直接推算的位移。將位移均勻攤到過長距離會低估局部應變，管線在狹窄剪切帶可先破裂；沒有明顯地表噴砂也不能單獨排除深層側移的影響。
改良前後循環抗力比較應保持相同應力及震級基準，且考慮土層代表性。抗力增幅不是安全係數增幅，除非同時證明需求、修正及載重狀態均相同。假設相容CRRold=0.30、CRRnew=0.45，抗力比0.45/0.30=1.50；只有CSR相同時觸發比值才同比增加。地盤加載可能同時改變有效應力與需求，若只看抗力增加就宣稱風險下降，會漏掉新增結構荷載及水位改變造成的不利效果與空間差異。
周圍土震後下沉相對於樁身會形成負摩阻，增加樁的軸力需求。簡化沿程均勻剪應力只提供量級，實際中性點、樁土相對位移及荷載轉移需共同分析。假設樁徑D=1m、受負摩阻長L=8m、平均τ=20kPa，Qdrag=πDLτ=502.7kN，約503kN；不得與同段正摩阻重複計入。同一樁段一面計負摩阻需求一面又計滿額正摩阻抗力會重複使用界面能力；震後樁身軸力可能因此被低估，接頭與樁端更容易過載。
改良成果需證明空間覆蓋及深度，不只是提交合格試驗的數量。已驗證面積比例適合追蹤資料完整性，未驗證區的位置及連通性仍可能控制整個系統。假設目標面積1000m²、符合既定證據要求900m²，覆蓋率=900/1000=90%；剩餘100m²不因平均比例高而自動合格。未驗證區若形成跨越基礎的連續帶，即使占比小也可能主導側移；以報告頁數或試驗總數替代空間覆蓋，會造成系統安全的假象。
觸發判定對需求及抗力都有不確定性，交接應保留情境範圍和最不利位置。兩個需求值的比較只顯示模型敏感度，不代表地震發生機率或永久變形大小。固定教學CRR=0.40時，CSR=0.30得FS=1.33，CSR=0.40得FS=1.00；需求提高會降低同基準抗力比。若新增開挖或地下水改變後仍沿用原比值，風險資料會失去時效；只保存合格結論而未保存假設，接手工程師無法辨識哪些條件已經改變。
procedureEn: Soil-skeleton effective stress is total stress minus pressure. Rapid earthquake cycling can change pressure without immediately changing overburden weight, so initial conditions require stratigraphy, groundwater and stress history. At a selected depth with σv=150kPa and u=100kPa, σ′v=50kPa. This is an initial state, not a liquefaction determination. Using total stress as effective stress distorts demand and resistance corrections. Higher actual groundwater reduces initial skeletal stress and can remove an apparently adequate margin in the original evaluation.

A simplified cyclic stress ratio combines acceleration, stress ratio and depth reduction within a compatible triggering method. It is not a full time-history soil response, and complex sites or important assets may need more detailed analysis. For amax/g=0.30, σv/σ′v=2 and rd=0.90, CSR=0.65×0.30×2×0.90=0.351; all factors are dimensionless. Substituting bedrock motion for surface motion or confusing acceleration units with g changes demand systematically. Spreadsheet precision cannot correct omitted site amplification or an inconsistent input definition.

Cyclic resistance and demand must share magnitude, stress and correction references before division. A ratio above unity does not itself establish acceptable permanent deformation, thin-layer response or system performance. With compatibly corrected CRR=0.40 and CSR=0.351, FS=1.14. This teaching ratio is not a field acceptance threshold. Mixing corrections from incompatible methods can silently overstate resistance. An average ratio above unity may conceal a continuous weak layer responsible for lateral movement or a sharp loss of support.

A high excess-pressure ratio indicates substantial loss of initial effective stress, while stress path and cyclic strain remain important. One sensor cannot establish simultaneous full liquefaction across a site. For initial σ′v0=100kPa and cyclic Δu=95kPa, ru=0.95. Approximately fixed total stress leaves about5kPa effective stress. Insufficient range can clip the response while air leakage can suppress peaks. A single maximum without waveform review can misrepresent the extent of liquefaction and subsequent deformation demand.

Drainage and reconsolidation after shaking cause volumetric change, requiring integration over layer thickness. Suitable methods establish strains; a triggering factor cannot simply be converted linearly into surface settlement. For H1=3m, H2=4m, εv1=0.02 and εv2=0.01, S=Σ εviHi=0.10m, assuming predominantly vertical, one-dimensional reconsolidation of both layers. Omitting a thin high-strain lens understates settlement. Spatial variation can exceed joint movement limits even with a moderate site average, so average subsidence alone cannot establish serviceability.

Liquefied ground near a free face or slope can move laterally, imposing demands unlike vertical settlement. Mean shear strain describes a selected band width but does not resolve localized shear concentration. For relative permanent movement Δ=0.30m across L=5m, γ≈0.06, or6%. This assumed movement is not derived directly from earthquake magnitude. Spreading displacement across too long a distance understates local strain and can miss rupture at a narrow band. Absence of obvious sand boils does not exclude damaging deep lateral movement.

Compare cyclic resistance before and after treatment on common stress and magnitude references. Resistance gain is not necessarily a safety-factor gain unless demand, corrections and loading also remain unchanged. For compatible CRRold=0.30 and CRRnew=0.45, resistance gain is1.50. The triggering ratio increases proportionally only if CSR stays unchanged. New loading can change both effective stress and demand. Claiming lower risk from resistance alone overlooks adverse effects of added structure load, changed groundwater and spatial variation.

Reconsolidating soil moving down relative to a pile adds downdrag. Uniform interface shear provides a scale estimate, while the neutral plane, relative movement and load transfer require integrated analysis. For D=1m, downdrag length L=8m and mean τ=20kPa, Qdrag=πDLτ=502.7kN, about503kN. Do not also credit positive friction over that segment. Crediting full positive resistance while assigning downdrag on the same segment double counts interface capacity. This can understate post-event axial force and expose connections or toes to overload.

Treatment evidence must establish spatial and depth coverage, not merely count passing tests. A verified-area fraction tracks completeness, while the location and continuity of remaining gaps may control system performance. For a1000m² target and900m² meeting predefined evidence requirements, coverage is90%. The remaining100m² is not automatically acceptable because the overall fraction is high. A small unverified strip crossing the foundation can control lateral deformation. Report length or total test count is not spatial coverage and can create a false impression of system reliability.

Both demand and resistance are uncertain, so handover preserves scenario ranges and controlling locations. Comparing two demand values illustrates model sensitivity, not earthquake probability or permanent deformation magnitude. At fixed teaching CRR=0.40, CSR=0.30 gives FS=1.33, while CSR=0.40 gives FS=1.00. Higher demand lowers the consistently referenced ratio. Later excavation or groundwater changes can invalidate the original ratio. Retaining only a passing conclusion without assumptions prevents the next engineer from identifying which boundary conditions have changed.
evidence: 交接飽和土有效應力時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。以單位重積分核對總應力，將地下水位及測點孔壓轉為同一高程。季節或承壓含水層差異須列成情境，不能用單次乾季讀值代表地震設計水位。
交接循環應力需求時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。核對地震輸入的基準位置、加速度定義及折減係數來源，將採用的震級與持續時間處理方式寫清楚。場址反應需與所選經驗觸發法一致，避免重複修正。
交接觸發抗力比值時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。保存貫入試驗原始資料與每項修正，逐層檢查細料、應力及震級基準是否一致。將抗力與需求的不確定性一併審查，由岩土工程師訂定所需可靠度。
交接超額孔壓接近極限時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。量測孔壓須同步加速度與變形，檢查飽和、零點、動態範圍及位置。比較多深度反應，區別儀器截頂、局部噴砂通道與可代表土層的行為。
交接分層震後沉陷時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。比較震前後水準測量、地下沉陷及地層分布，辨別側移或基礎轉動造成的表觀沉陷。將每層應變來源與適用範圍列入計算書，保留不確定區間。
evidenceEn: When handing over effective stress in saturated soil, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Integrate unit weights for total stress and reconcile water levels and pressures on one datum. Seasonal and confined-aquifer differences need scenarios rather than one dry-season reading representing design groundwater.

When handing over cyclic stress demand, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Check motion reference location, acceleration definition and reduction-factor source, documenting magnitude and duration treatment. Keep site-response assumptions consistent with the empirical triggering method to avoid duplicate corrections.

When handing over triggering resistance ratio, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Retain penetration data and every correction, checking fines, stress and magnitude conventions by layer. Review demand and resistance uncertainty together, with the geotechnical engineer defining the required reliability.

When handing over high excess pressure ratio, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Synchronize pressure with acceleration and movement, checking saturation, zero, range and location. Compare depths to distinguish clipping, local vent paths and representative layer response.

When handing over layered post shaking settlement, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Compare pre- and post-event levels, subsurface settlement and stratigraphy, distinguishing lateral movement or foundation rotation. Document each layer's strain source, applicable range and uncertainty.
pitfalls: 若把總應力當有效應力，循環需求與抗力修正都可能失真；實際水位較高時初始骨架應力更低，原本看似充足的安全餘裕可能消失。
把不同文獻的修正係數任意混用，可能在無察覺下高估抗力；平均比值大於一也可能掩蓋連續薄弱層，造成側移或地盤支承能力突變。
遺漏薄但高應變的夾層會低估總沉陷；相同平均沉陷在相鄰位置若分布不同，結構接頭可能已超限，不能只用場地總平均判斷可使用性。
地盤加載可能同時改變有效應力與需求，若只看抗力增加就宣稱風險下降，會漏掉新增結構荷載及水位改變造成的不利效果與空間差異。
未驗證區若形成跨越基礎的連續帶，即使占比小也可能主導側移；以報告頁數或試驗總數替代空間覆蓋，會造成系統安全的假象。
pitfallsEn: Using total stress as effective stress distorts demand and resistance corrections. Higher actual groundwater reduces initial skeletal stress and can remove an apparently adequate margin in the original evaluation.

Mixing corrections from incompatible methods can silently overstate resistance. An average ratio above unity may conceal a continuous weak layer responsible for lateral movement or a sharp loss of support.

Omitting a thin high-strain lens understates settlement. Spatial variation can exceed joint movement limits even with a moderate site average, so average subsidence alone cannot establish serviceability.
New loading can change both effective stress and demand. Claiming lower risk from resistance alone overlooks adverse effects of added structure load, changed groundwater and spatial variation.
A small unverified strip crossing the foundation can control lateral deformation. Report length or total test count is not spatial coverage and can create a false impression of system reliability.

related.title: 振動碎石樁施工
related.transfer: 可遷移「飽和土有效應力」與「改善抗力增幅」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；振動碎石樁施工的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Effective stress in saturated soil" and "Treatment resistance gain" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Vibro-replacement stone columns must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦區分液化觸發、永久變形與改善覆蓋的驗證需求；振動碎石樁施工則以連結碎石樁置換率、側向拘束與排水證據判斷複合地盤為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on separate liquefaction triggering, permanent deformation and verified treatment coverage; Vibro-replacement stone columns centres on relate stone column replacement, lateral confinement and drainage evidence to composite ground, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「飽和土有效應力」與「方格置換面積」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到振動碎石樁施工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「排水時間尺度」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Effective stress in saturated soil” and “Square grid replacement area”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Vibro-replacement stone columns, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Drainage time scale", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 液化地盤評估與改善
history.text: 本課以公開工程研究與機構文件建立區分液化觸發、永久變形與改善覆蓋的驗證需求的背景。灣區捷運完成系統耐震脆弱度研究（2002）。美國聯邦公路管理局列出岩土耐震參考手冊（2011）。美國聯邦公路管理局列出地盤改良參考手冊（2017）。兩個地標用來比較環境、量測與維護證據，並非宣稱本課每一教學構件都實際用於兩處。來源若只可讀摘要，適用範圍已另行註明；現場設計須重新確認規範版本與責任。本課只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: This course uses public research and institutional documents to establish context for separate liquefaction triggering, permanent deformation and verified treatment coverage. BART completes a system seismic vulnerability study (2002). FHWA lists its seismic geotechnical reference manual (2011). FHWA lists its ground modification reference manual (2017). The two landmarks compare environments, measurements and maintenance evidence; they do not imply that every teaching component was installed at both sites. Abstract-only access is declared in source scopes. Field design requires current applicability and responsible review. This course reconstructs public principles only.
